sheet_text = entries[sheet_path].decode('utf-8')

    t = m.group(1) if m else None
    vm = re.search(r'<v>(.*?)</v>', cell_xml, re.S)

        return shared[int(vm.group(1).strip())]
    if t == 'inlineStr':
        return html.unescape(''.join(re.findall(r'<t[^>]*>(.*?)</t>', cell_xml, re.S)))
    if vm:
        return vm.group(1)
    return None

header_row = profit_col = rev_col = cost_col = None
for rn in range(1, 21):

    if not rv:
        rv = [ci for ci, s in cells.items() if 'sales' in s]
    co = [ci for ci, s in cells.items() if 'cost' in s or 'cogs' in s]
    if p and rv:
        header_row, profit_col, rev_col = rn, p[0], rv[0]
        if co:
            cost_col = co[0]
        break

    if cellXfs_m:
        xfs = re.compile(r'<xf\b[^>]*?(?:/>|>.*?</xf>)', re.S).findall(cellXfs_m.group(1))
        # most common style among revenue-column data cells
        usage = {}
        for rn in range(header_row + 1, max_row + 1):
            row_m = re.search(r'<row\b[^>]*\br="%d"[^>]*>(.*?)</row>' % rn, sheet_text, re.S)

                    usage[sm.group(1)] = usage.get(sm.group(1), 0) + 1
        base_idx = max(usage, key=usage.get) if usage else None

            nm = re.search(r'(<numFmts\b[^>]*>)(.*?)(</numFmts>)', styles_text, re.S)
            if nm:
                tag = nm.group(1)
                cnt = re.search(r'count="(\d+)"', tag)
                tag = re.sub(r'count="\d+"', 'count="%d"' % (int(cnt.group(1)) + 1), tag, count=1) if cnt else tag
                styles_text = styles_text[:nm.start(1)] + tag + nm.group(2) + nf_xml + nm.group(3) + styles_text[nm.end(3):]
            else:
                m3 = re.search(r'<styleSheet\b[^>]*>', styles_text)
                styles_text = styles_text[:m3.end()] + '<numFmts count="1">' + nf_xml + '</numFmts>' + styles_text[m3.end():]
        # new cellXf: clone base data style, override numFmtId to percent
        if base_xf:
            om = re.search(r'<xf\b([^>]*?)(?:/>|>)', base_xf)
            attrs = dict(attr_re.findall(om.group(1)))
        else:
            attrs = {'fontId': '0', 'fillId': '0', 'borderId': '0', 'xfId': '0'}
        attrs['numFmtId'] = str(percent_id)
        attrs['applyNumberFormat'] = '1'
        new_xf = '<xf ' + ' '.join('%s="%s"' % kv for kv in attrs.items()) + '/>'
        tag = cellXfs_m.re.group(1) if hasattr(cellXfs_m.re, 'group') else None
        # recompute opening tag via search on current text
        cm2 = re.search(r'(<cellXfs\b[^>]*>)(.*?)(</cellXfs>)', styles_text, re.S)
        ctag = cm2.group(1)
        ccnt = re.search(r'count="(\d+)"', ctag)
        ctag = re.sub(r'count="\d+"', 'count="%d"' % (int(ccnt.group(1)) + 1), ctag, count=1) if ccnt else ctag
        styles_text = styles_text[:cm2.start(1)] + ctag + cm2.group(2) + new_xf + cm2.group(3) + styles_text[cm2.end(3):]
        percent_style = str(len(xfs))

    global sheet_text
    row_m = re.search(r'<row\b[^>]*\br="%d"[^>]*>(.*?)</row>' % rn, sheet_text, re.S)
    if not row_m:
        return False
    body = row_m.group(2)
    pos = 0
    for cm in cell_re.finditer(body):
        ref_m = re.search(r'\br="([A-Z]+)\d+"', cm.group(0))
        if ref_m and col_index(ref_m.group(1)) < col:
            pos = cm.end()
        else:
            break
    new_body = body[:pos] + cell_xml + body[pos:]
    open_tag = row_m.group(1)
    if 'spans=' in open_tag:
        cols = [col_index(mm.group(1)) for mm in re.finditer(r'\br="([A-Z]+)\d+"', new_body)]
        if cols:
            open_tag = re.sub(r'spans="[^"]*"', 'spans="%d:%d"' % (min(cols), max(cols)), open_tag, count=1)
    sheet_text = sheet_text[:row_m.start()] + open_tag + new_body + row_m.group(3) + sheet_text[row_m.end():]
    return True

header_style = None
hrow_m = re.search(r'<row\b[^>]*\br="%d"[^>]*>(.*?)</row>' % header_row, sheet_text, re.S)
for cm in cell_re.finditer(hrow_m.group(1)):
    ref_m = re.search(r'\br="([A-Z]+)\d+"', cm.group(0))
    if ref_m and col_index(ref_m.group(1)) == rev_col:
        sm = re.search(r'\bs="(\d+)"', cm.group(0))
        if sm:

    new_letter, header_row, (' s="%s"' % header_style) if header_style else '')
insert_cell_in_row(header_row, header_cell, new_col)

# Formula cells
added = 0
for rn in range(header_row + 1, max_row + 1):
    row_m = re.search(r'<row\b[^>]*\br="%d"[^>]*>(.*?)</row>' % rn, sheet_text, re.S)
    if not row_m or not cell_re.search(row_m.group(1)):
        continue
    den = '%s%d' % (col_letter(rev_col), rn)
    if profit_col:
        num = '%s%d' % (col_letter(profit_col), rn)
    elif cost_col:
        num = '(%s%d-%s%d)' % (col_letter(rev_col), rn, col_letter(cost_col), rn)
    else:
        continue
    formula = 'IFERROR(%s/%s,0)' % (num, den)
    sattr = ' s="%s"' % percent_style if percent_style is not None else ''
    cell_xml = '<c r="%s%d"%s><f>%s</f><v>0</v></c>' % (new_letter, rn, sattr, formula)
    if insert_cell_in_row(rn, cell_xml, new_col):
        added += 1
print('formula cells added:', added)

# Refresh dimension
refs = []
for cm in cell_re.finditer(sheet_text):
    ref_m = re.search(r'\br="([A-Z]+)(\d+)"', cm.group(0))
    if ref_m:
        refs.append((col_index(ref_m.group(1)), int(ref_m.group(2))))
dim_ref = '%s%d:%s%d' % (col_letter(min(c for c, r in refs)), min(r for c, r in refs),
                         col_letter(max(c for c, r in refs)), max(r for c, r in refs))
if '<dimension' in sheet_text:
    sheet_text = re.sub(r'<dimension\b[^>]*/>', '<dimension ref="%s"/>' % dim_ref, sheet_text, count=1)

entries[sheet_path] = sheet_text.encode('utf-8')
if styles_text is not None:
    entries['xl/styles.xml'] = styles_text.encode('utf-8')

tmp = SRC + '.tmp'
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name, data in entries.items():
        zout.writestr(name, data)
os.replace(tmp, SRC)
print('Saved', SRC, '- new column', new_letter, '="Profit Margin (%)"')

def col_letter(idx):
    s = ''
    while idx:
        idx, rem = divmod(idx - 1, 26)
        s = chr(65 + rem) + s
    return s


def col_index(letters):
    n = 0
    for ch in letters:
        n = n * 26 + (ord(ch.upper()) - 64)
    return n


cell_re = re.compile(r'<c\b[^>]*?(?:/>|>.*?</c>)', re.S)

def cell_value(cell_xml):
    m = re.search(r'\bt="([^"]+)"', cell_xml)
    t = m.group(1) if m else None
    vm = re.search(r'<v>(.*?)</v>', cell_xml, re.S)
    if t == 's' and vm:
        return shared[int(vm.group(1).strip())]
    if t == 'inlineStr':
        return html.unescape(''.join(re.findall(r'<t[^>]*>(.*?)</t>', cell_xml, re.S)))
    if vm:
        return vm.group(1)
    return None

def insert_cell_in_row(rn, cell_xml, col):

    row_m = re.search(r'(<row\b[^>]*\br="%d"[^>]*>)(.*?)(</row>)' % rn, sheet_text, re.S)
    if not row_m:
        return False
    open_tag, body, close_tag = row_m.group(1), row_m.group(2), row_m.group(3)
    pos = 0
    for cm in cell_re.finditer(body):
        ref_m = re.search(r'\br="([A-Z]+)\d+"', cm.group(0))
        if ref_m and col_index(ref_m.group(1)) < col:

        else:

        if cols:
            open_tag = re.sub(r'spans="[^"]*"', 'spans="%d:%d"' % (min(cols), max(cols)), open_tag, count=1)
    sheet_text = sheet_text[:row_m.start()] + open_tag + new_body + close_tag + sheet_text[row_m.end():]
    return True
